description: A single-panel, spin-polarised density-of-states (DOS) plot for the alloy labelled at top-left "b Fe0.875Mn0.125Al" — the "b" prefix indicates it is panel (b) of a larger multi-panel figure. Y-axis: "DOS / (States·eV⁻¹·atom⁻¹)", ticks labelled −2, −1, 0, 1, 2; X-axis: "Energy / eV", spanning −10 to 20 with ticks at −10, −5, 0, 5, 10, 15, 20. The legend (right side, two blocks) lists ten curves: total "Up-states" (thick black) and "Down-states" (thick red), plus partial DOS in the up-spin channel — "Up-Al-s", "Up-Al-p", "Up-Fe-d", "Up-Mn-d" — and the matching down-spin set "Down-Al-s", "Down-Al-p", "Down-Fe-d", "Down-Mn-d". The dominant structure sits at the Fermi level (0 eV): a large up-spin Mn-d/Fe-d peak rising just below 0 eV (the total up-states curve peaks between the 1 and 2 gridlines) and a deep negative down-spin Mn-d/Fe-d dip just at/above 0 eV (total down-states dips between the −1 and −2 gridlines), giving a pronounced spin splitting. Al-s and Al-p partials remain near zero throughout. Above roughly 5 eV every curve is small and oscillatory about zero, indicating delocalised states. This panel demonstrates the orbital-resolved, strongly spin-polarised electronic structure dominated by Fe-d and Mn-d states at the Fermi level.

subfigures.description: Spin-polarised DOS vs Energy for Fe0.875Mn0.125Al, y-axis DOS in States·eV⁻¹·atom⁻¹ (−2 to 2) and x-axis Energy in eV (−10 to 20). Ten legend entries give total up-/down-states plus partial Al-s, Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d DOS in both spin channels; Fe-d and Mn-d dominate with strong peaks/dips at the Fermi level (0 eV), while Al-s and Al-p stay near zero.

observations.observation: The plot is a spin-polarised density-of-states curve for the composition Fe0.875Mn0.125Al, labelled as panel 'b'.
The abscissa is 'Energy / eV' from −10 to 20 and the ordinate is 'DOS / (States·eV⁻¹·atom⁻¹)' from −2 to 2 (integer ticks −2,−1,0,1,2).
The legend contains ten entries: Up-states, Up-Al-s, Up-Al-p, Up-Fe-d, Up-Mn-d, Down-states, Down-Al-s, Down-Al-p, Down-Fe-d, Down-Mn-d.
In the up-spin channel a large Fe-d/Mn-d peak rises immediately below the Fermi level (0 eV) and the total up-states curve peaks between the 1 and 2 gridlines.
In the down-spin channel a deep negative Fe-d/Mn-d dip occurs at/just above 0 eV, with the total down-states curve dipping between the −1 and −2 gridlines.
The up-spin and down-spin DOS display opposite signs across the Fermi level, indicating pronounced spin splitting of the Fe-d and Mn-d states.
The Al-s and Al-p partial DOS curves stay close to zero over the whole energy range, showing negligible Al contribution near the Fermi level.
At energies above roughly 5 eV all curves are small and oscillatory about zero, consistent with delocalised free-electron-like states.
